Can you make this reply sound less defensive?

From: {PERSON1} <p.ops@example.com>
To: {PERSON2} <finance-team@example.com>
Cc: {PERSON3.initial}
Subject: RE: Q3 invoices

Hi {PERSON2.first},
The invoices were sent on Monday as agreed. I'm not sure why they didn't reach you.
Best,
{PERSON1.first}
Rewrite this out-of-office so it sounds friendlier: "I am out of the office until June 14 with limited access to email. For urgent matters contact {PERSON1} at backup@example.com or +1 555 0100."

Summarize this thread in three bullet points:

> On Tue, {PERSON1.firstlast2} wrote:
> The vendor still hasn't signed. Mark the contract as at risk.
> On Wed, {PERSON2.first} wrote:
> I will call them tomorrow and hope for the best.

We will not be renewing the agreement in its current form. Please forward any questions to {PERSON2.full} in Legal.
Regards,
{PERSON3.initial}

write a short apology email to {PERSON1.lower} for missing the call, keep it casual, she's a friend

Make this email shorter. Keep the dates.

Hello team,
As you know, the Summer offsite moves from July to September because the venue in {LOCATION1.city} double-booked. {PERSON1.first} and {PERSON2.first} are reworking the agenda. We may also add a half day for the Hope Foundation volunteering session.
Thanks,
{PERSON3}
Extract every name and role from this Cc line into a table: Cc: {PERSON1} (CFO); {PERSON2.initial} (Controller); {PERSON3.firstlast2} (Tax); payroll@example.com
Write a reply declining the invitation. The original says: "Hi there, {PERSON1.first} here from the Rose & Crown events team. Would you speak at our Grace Hopper Day panel on 3 March?"

Translate the tone of this email into something a vendor would appreciate:

To: support@example.net
From: {PERSON1.upper}
Your last shipment to {ADDRESS1.en_street} arrived damaged again. This is the third time. Fix it.
Can you rephrase this so it doesn't sound like I'm blaming anyone? "The delay is not on our side. {PERSON1.first} confirmed the specs on Friday and {PERSON2.full} approved them the same day."

Write an auto-reply for the support inbox: thanks for your message, we answer within two business days, Monday to Friday, 9am-6pm. No names please.
Rewrite this email subject line so it's clearer: "re: re: fwd: that thing from may (will check)"
How should I start an email to someone senior I've never met? Give me three openings, formal to casual.
Suggest a better structure for our team's email template for incident reports: summary, impact, timeline, root cause, next steps.
My manager {PERSON1.full} moved to {LOCATION1.country} and asked me to keep her updated weekly. Draft the first update email covering hiring, budget and the March release.

İzindeyim mesajı yaz: 20 Ağustos'a kadar ofis dışındayım, acil durumlarda {PERSON1.full} ile iletişime geçebilirsiniz (0532 000 11 22).
